floors.covers: Vectors, the dot product and cosine similarity: how similarity search ranks chunks.

formulas.text: The dot product of a and b is the sum of a-i times b-i, over every position i.
Cosine similarity is the dot product of a and b, divided by the length of a times the length of b.

formulas.text: The mean, x-bar, is the sum of all values x-i, divided by the number of values n.

floors.covers: Matrix multiply, and a layer as y = Wx + b.

formulas.text: The output y is the weight matrix W times the input x, plus the bias b.

floors.covers: Logits to probabilities, and what temperature changes.

formulas.text: The probability of option i is e to the power of (z-i divided by T), divided by the sum of e to the power of (z-j divided by T) over every option j. z is the logit for each option and T is the temperature.
Update the parameters theta: subtract the learning rate eta times the gradient of the loss L.

floors.covers: Loss, and why LLM training tries to lower it.

formulas.text: Cross-entropy is minus the sum, over every class, of the true probability y times the log of the predicted probability y-hat.

floors.covers: Queries, keys and values: the math of attention.

formulas.text: Multiply the queries Q by the keys K transposed, divide by the square root of the key size d, apply softmax, then multiply by the values V.
